name: What is a standard laundry room doorway width versus a widened one?

mainEntity.name: What is a standard laundry room doorway width versus a widened one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard interior doorways are typically 28 to 32 inches wide. For laundry rooms, many older homes might have 24-inch or 28-inch openings, which are too narrow for modern appliances. A widened laundry room doorway often aims for 32 to 36 inches, providing ample clearance for current and future larger washing machines and dryers. Some homeowners might opt for even wider openings for enhanced accessibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard doorways are 28-32 inches. Widened laundry doorways are typically 32-36 inches to accommodate modern appliances and improve access.
